# Step - as_local

`as_local` · category: [Dates and times](../../traversal/step_reference.md#dates-and-times)

A datetime's wall clock.

## Forms

```text
as_local()
as_local(arg1: string)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.inject(datetime("2023-08-02T12:00Z")).as_local().next().hour   // 12
```
